current_point.claim: 提出了一种新的基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络训练框架，称为DSGNN，用于分布式场景下的基于图神经网络的图表示学习。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed a new distributed graph neural network training framework based on graph summarization, called DSGNN, for graph representation learning based on graph neural networks in distributed scenarios.
technical_features: 可以在工作节点上对子图进行小批量样本的学习，而不是让领导节点完成子图生成。
使用图摘要技术生成的子图规模远远小于原图，在其基础上进行模型训练可以大大提升效率。
technical_features_en: Can perform mini-batch sample learning on subgraphs at worker nodes instead of having the leader node complete subgraph generation.
The subgraphs generated using graph summarization technology have a much smaller scale than the original graph, allowing for efficient model training based on them.
